_why: #154: the evidence gate must refuse a transcript it cannot read (codex-text) as UNREADABLE reason=unsupported_format, never score it as tools=0. Three guards: the scanner's format count, the CLI's refusal, and the archreview driver's refusal.

mutations.name: cli-scores-a-codex-text-log-as-tools-0
mutations._mechanism: The original defect: EVIDENCE: NONE tools=0 on a codex review that read the tree. The gate's zero is not a measurement when the instrument cannot read the input.

mutations.name: scanner-never-sees-an-agy-event
mutations._mechanism: The format signal goes dark: every transcript reads as unsupported, so an agy run that called no tool is no longer distinguishable from a foreign file.

mutations.name: archreview-driver-skips-the-format-check
mutations._mechanism: The driver imports scan() directly, so a fix in the CLI alone leaves 6a-prime's scored path reporting NO_EVIDENCE tools=0 on a codex-text log.
